fields.statement: At 65b2e01fe, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/... -run 'DaemonProfile|Describe' -v passes (also under -race): TestDaemonProfile runs daemonLoop in-process with test-driven ticks and a fake capture clock, issues daemon.profile with seconds 1 and --out, asserts the 1s capture timer, a non-empty gzip pprof at --out, polls during and after the capture, and a second request refused with 'a profile capture is already in progress'; TestDaemonProfileDefaultPath checks the default path lands in the root's state folder; TestDaemonProfileNoDaemon checks the no-daemon error. The request and result travel as files in .rhiza-root, so no socket is bound. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(describe|help|docs|daemon|usage|reference)' passes. A scratch build hides the op from 'rhiza daemon --help' while 'rhiza daemon profile --help' shows --seconds (default 30) and --out. Diff read: Hidden flag filters help, subcommands, docs, check and unfiltered describe.
